content.text: A new Japanese restaurant has recently opened near my company, and it looks quite good.
Look at this sushi platter; it has quite a variety of ingredients.
Wow, this sushi looks really tempting, and the color combination is great too. But isn't this kind of place a bit expensive? I'm more inclined to find places with good value for money.
Indeed, I suppose the price isn't low. Do you have any good recommendations?

Well, I've been looking for some affordable restaurants lately. By the way, you mentioned before that you like automated solutions, like automatic feeders. Are you also pursuing efficiency when it comes to eating now?
Haha, yes, I always want to save trouble and effort. But when it comes to eating, it's nice to relax occasionally. I found a Sichuan restaurant with quite reasonable prices.
This is their menu. Look, they have classic dishes like boiled fish and mapo tofu, and the prices are quite reasonable.
Oh, Sichuan cuisine? I've been wanting to try it for a long time, and the price does seem reasonable. How's the atmosphere in the restaurant? I don't really like places that are too noisy or chaotic.

I haven't been there yet, but according to the reviews, the atmosphere is quite peaceful. When you shared the almond photos earlier, you mentioned liking a decent balance, so this place should meet your expectations.
Thank you for remembering this! That's great. A quiet environment is more suitable for chatting. Can we book a private room? That would be more private.
I checked, and it seems they have private rooms. Look at this environment picture—the tables and chairs are neatly arranged, and the lighting is soft, so it shouldn't be too noisy.
It does look quite peaceful, and the wooden decor has a distinct Chinese style. So, let's set a time. Are you free this weekend?
Saturday evening works. Is it just the two of us this time, or would you like to invite others?
Just the two of us, it's more relaxed this way. Since our last conversation about almonds, I've found chatting with you quite enjoyable and would like to get to know you better, my pragmatic friend.
Okay, I also think you are thoughtful and considerate, and it's very comfortable to be around you. So let's set it for Saturday at 6 p.m., at Shu Xiang Qing. I'll book a private room in advance.
Perfect! Looking forward to this gathering. By the way, have you been busy with work lately? Don’t go automating your meals again just to save effort like last time.
Haha, work is going okay, I'm currently optimizing a project. As for eating, I'll definitely make sure to enjoy it properly. See you on Saturday!
See you on Saturday! We can chat more then, and maybe even share some life hacks, like how you were interested in automatic feeders before.
